verdict.rationale: Reaching files and repositories held in other apps' sandboxes on the same device is a local file-provider or editor capability, which falls outside a network-connectivity VPN's category. Taildrive (folder sharing between devices) and Taildrop (sending files between devices) are cross-device networking features. Neither is documented as giving access to other apps' sandboxes on the same device, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.
